title: dendrophthora obliqua
intro: Dendrophthora obliqua, commonly known as the "witch's broom plant", is a type of parasitic plant that grows on the branches of its host plant, often causing deformation and altering the host's growth patterns. The witch's broom plant has been found to have various health benefits, including antifungal and antibacterial properties, which can aid in the treatment of infections and wounds. It is also believed to have therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and promoting healing, due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive compounds present in the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
